# K. Eric Drexler — Research and writing

> An entry point to K. Eric Drexler's research library and writing. Research and library items have their own authorship, version, status, and rights information.

## Research library

- [Library reading guide](https://ericdrexler.github.io/research-library/llms.txt): a plain-text guide linking to library material.
- [Library catalogue](https://ericdrexler.github.io/research-library/INDEX.md): items, authors, dates, status, and descriptions.
- [Library overview and rights](https://ericdrexler.github.io/research-library/README.md): purpose, structure, and reuse terms.
- [Library conventions](https://ericdrexler.github.io/research-library/CONVENTIONS.md): metadata and organisation.
- [Library website](https://ericdrexler.github.io/research-library/): HTML pages and links to plain-text files.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/ericdrexler/research-library): source files and revision history.

## Other entry points

- [Homepage](https://ericdrexler.github.io/): the public landing page.
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/ericdrexler): public repositories.
- [AI Prospects](https://aiprospects.substack.com/): Substack writing.

## Attribution and rights

The library is maintained by K. Eric Drexler, but not every item is authored by him. Consult each item's metadata. The library states CC0 with exceptions, including third-party works and quotations; do not assume that every linked work shares that dedication.
